en: An old sepia-toned photographic postcard featuring a large, ornate brick building with a prominent central clock tower and dome. A wooden walkway leads up to the building, which is surrounded by grass and a few trees. The building design features arches above the windows and classical decorative elements. There is printed text at the bottom right identifying the location and handwritten or stamped numbers at the top right.
